$doc: Pass/fail limits of node e2e/run-e2e.mjs (initial values; tighten as the engine matures). Resolution per run: default <- <meta.scene> (object | yard) <- datasets[<dataset name>]. Check names and their meaning: e2e/lib/e2e-checks.mjs (CHECKS). {min, max} bound the value; 'claims' require the result's MetricInfo to claim a property when the sensors it needs were passed (metric / gravityAligned: IMU or GPS; northAligned: compass or GPS). Checks of properties that are not claimed (scale, gravity, heading) and dense checks without a dense run are skipped. registrationRate is registered / images the engine tried (stats.images, else live keyframes). Yard dense limits are lower than object: with EXACT poses the dense stage reaches ~0.23-0.34 completeness at tau = 0.1 m on that 120 m scene (e2e/README.md, dense-gt reference run).
